text.en: In the Shizunai dialect of Southwestern Hokkaido, intervocalic *-w-* or *-y-* often appears epenthetically between an open syllable and a following vowel-initial syllable, both within words and compounds and between words in the same clause ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--intervocalic-w-or-y-often-appears-epenthetically-between⟧. For example, *tooka pe* is generally pronounced [tookajpe] in that dialect ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--tooka-pe-is-generally-pronounced-tookajpe⟧. In Chitose, when the prefix *e-* attaches to the verb *ipe* 'to dine', glide epenthesis occurs, yielding *e-ype* [ejpe] ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-the-prefix-e-attaches-to-the-verb⟧. The consonant *y* is likewise inserted when the reflexive prefix *si-* attaches to a vowel-initial form, as in *si-y-osmak* ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--the-consonant-y-is-inserted-when-the-reflexive⟧.
text.ja: 北海道南西部の静内方言では、開音節とそれに続く母音始まりの音節の間に、単語内・複合語内だけでなく同一節内の単語間でも、母音間渡り音*-w-*または*-y-*がしばしば挿入される⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--intervocalic-w-or-y-often-appears-epenthetically-between⟧。例えば*tooka pe*は一般に[tookajpe]と発音される⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--tooka-pe-is-generally-pronounced-tookajpe⟧。千歳方言では、接頭辞*e-*が動詞*ipe*「食事する」に付くと渡り音挿入が生じ、*e-ype*[ejpe]となる⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-the-prefix-e-attaches-to-the-verb⟧。同様に、再帰接頭辞*si-*が母音で始まる形式に付く際にも子音*y*が挿入され、*si-y-osmak*のような形が生じる⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--the-consonant-y-is-inserted-when-the-reflexive⟧。

text.en: Glides *y* and *w* are inserted to resolve vowel hiatus when the preceding vowel is /i/ or /u/, respectively ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--glide-insertion-after-high-vowels⟧. More specifically, when the prefix *i-* attaches to a vowel-initial stem, *y* is epenthesized between them (*i-* + V- → *i-y-V-*), and when the prefix *u-* attaches to a vowel-initial stem, *w* is epenthesized (*u-* + V- → *u-w-V-*) ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-the-prefix-i-attaches-to-a-vowel⟧⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-the-prefix-u-attaches-to-a-vowel⟧. The prefix *i-* obligatorily triggers insertion of *y* when it precedes the vowels *e*, *a*, *o*, or *u* ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--the-glide-y-is-obligatorily-inserted-when-the⟧, as illustrated by the adverb *iyos* 'after that', formed from *os* 'after, behind' with the indefinite prefix *i-* and an epenthetic *y* ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--the-adverb-iyos-after-that-is-formed-from⟧. Glide insertion is triggered only by a restricted subset of prefixes such as *i-*, *u-*, or *si-*, and does not occur after person prefixes like *eci-* or incorporated stems ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--prefix-conditioned-glide-insertion⟧. In Southwestern Hokkaido (Chitose), this restriction is likewise reported: glide insertion occurs only after *i-*, *si-*, and *u-*, but not after *eci=* or incorporated noun stems ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--prefix-conditioned-glide-insertion-sw⟧. In the Southwestern dialect, glide insertion of /j/ occurs when the first vowel is /i/ and the second is /a, e, o, u/, with the glottal stop before the second vowel dropping ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--glide-insertion-of-j-occurs-between-two-vowels⟧, while insertion of /w/ occurs when the first vowel is /u/ and the second is /a, e, o/, again with loss of the preceding glottal stop ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--glide-insertion-of-w-occurs-between-two-vowels⟧. Bugaeva further analyses glide formation (/i/ > /j/ and /u/ > /w/) in the Southwestern dialect as occurring only when /i/ or /u/ is preceded by (C)V-type prefixes that assign accent to the following syllable, such as *ku=*, *e=*, *i-*, *e-*, *ko-*, or *o-*, but not after *a=* or *eci=* ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--glide-formation-i-j-and-u-w-occurs⟧.
text.ja: 前行母音が/i/の場合は渡り音*y*が、/u/の場合は渡り音*w*が、母音連続の解消として挿入される⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--glide-insertion-after-high-vowels⟧。より具体的には、接頭辞*i-*が母音始まりの語幹に付く場合は*y*が挿入されて*i-* + V- → *i-y-V-*となり、接頭辞*u-*が母音始まりの語幹に付く場合は*w*が挿入されて*u-* + V- → *u-w-V-*となる⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-the-prefix-i-attaches-to-a-vowel⟧⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-the-prefix-u-attaches-to-a-vowel⟧。接頭辞*i-*が母音*e*、*a*、*o*、*u*の前に付く時には必ず渡り音*y*が挿入される⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--the-glide-y-is-obligatorily-inserted-when-the⟧。副詞*iyos*「その後から」は、*os*「後から」に不定の接頭辞*i-*が付き渡り音*y*が挿入されたものであり、その例証となる⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--the-adverb-iyos-after-that-is-formed-from⟧。渡り音挿入は*i-*、*u-*、*si-*などの一部の接頭辞によってのみ引き起こされ、*eci-*などの人称接頭辞や抱合語幹の後では生じない⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--prefix-conditioned-glide-insertion⟧。北海道南西部（千歳）方言においても同様の制限が報告されており、渡り音挿入は*i-*、*si-*、*u-*の後にのみ生じ、*eci=*や抱合名詞語幹の後では生じない⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--prefix-conditioned-glide-insertion-sw⟧。南西部方言では、第1母音が/i/で第2母音が/a, e, o, u/の場合に/j/の挿入が生じ、第2母音の前の声門閉鎖音が脱落する⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--glide-insertion-of-j-occurs-between-two-vowels⟧。第1母音が/u/で第2母音が/a, e, o/の場合には/w/が挿入され、同様に声門閉鎖音が脱落する⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--glide-insertion-of-w-occurs-between-two-vowels⟧。Bugaevaはさらに、南西部方言における渡り音形成（/i/ > /j/および/u/ > /w/）は、*ku=*、*e=*、*i-*、*e-*、*ko-*、*o-*のような後続音節にアクセントを付与する(C)V型接頭辞が/i/や/u/に先行する場合にのみ生じ、*a=*や*eci=*の後では生じないと分析する⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--glide-formation-i-j-and-u-w-occurs⟧。

text.en: Stem-initial unaccented *i-* alternates to *y-* when preceded by a prefix, as in *ko-ytak* from *ko-* + *itak*, but does not become *y-* when the stem has inherent first-syllable accent, as in *o'ika* from *o-* + *ika* ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--stem-initial-unaccented-i-alternates-to-y-when⟧. The prefix *i-* alternates to *y-* before a vowel-initial verb only when preceded by a person prefix that places accent immediately after itself, such as *ku-* or *e-*, yielding forms like *ku-yomare* ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--the-prefix-i-alternates-to-y-before-a⟧. Similarly, the prefix *u-* alternates to *w-* before a vowel-initial verb only under the same condition, yielding forms like *ku-womare* ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--the-prefix-u-alternates-to-w-before-a⟧. Initial *u-* can also alternate to *w-* between a vowel and a consonant, as in *e-wturentekehe* from *e-* + *uturentekehe*, though with lower regularity than the *i-* → *y-* alternation ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--initial-u-can-alternate-to-w-between-a⟧. An unaccented stem-initial *e* is pronounced [j] after the person prefix *a-* (*a-* + *e-* → [aj]) ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--an-unaccented-stem-initial-e-is-pronounced-j⟧, and an unaccented stem-initial *o* is pronounced [w] after *a-* (*a-* + *o-* → [aw]) ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--an-unaccented-stem-initial-o-is-pronounced-w⟧.
text.ja: 接頭辞が付くことで語幹頭のアクセントのない*i-*は*y-*となるが（*ko-ytak* < *ko-* + *itak*）、第一音節の*i*にもともとアクセントがある語の場合は*y-*にならない（*o'ika* < *o-* + *ika*）⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--stem-initial-unaccented-i-alternates-to-y-when⟧。接頭辞*i-*が母音で始まる動詞に付き、かつ*ku-*や*e-*のようにアクセントを直後に置く人称接頭辞が前に来た場合にのみ*i-* → *y-*の交替が起こり、*ku-yomare*のような形が生じる⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--the-prefix-i-alternates-to-y-before-a⟧。同様に、接頭辞*u-*が母音で始まる動詞に付き、同条件が満たされた場合にのみ*u-* → *w-*の交替が起こり、*ku-womare*のような形が生じる⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--the-prefix-u-alternates-to-w-before-a⟧。語頭の*u-*は母音と子音の間でも*w-*に交替することがあり（*e-wturentekehe* < *e-* + *uturentekehe*）、ただしその規則性は*i-* → *y-*の場合より低い⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--initial-u-can-alternate-to-w-between-a⟧。人称接頭辞*a-*の後に来たアクセントのない語幹頭の*e*は[j]と発音され（*a-* + *e-* → [aj]）⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--an-unaccented-stem-initial-e-is-pronounced-j⟧、アクセントのない語幹頭の*o*は[w]と発音される（*a-* + *o-* → [aw]）⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--an-unaccented-stem-initial-o-is-pronounced-w⟧。

text.en: When glide insertion is not available — because V1 is a non-high vowel (*e*, *a*, *o*) or because glide insertion is blocked for morphosyntactic reasons — glottal stop insertion takes place instead ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-glide-insertion-is-not-available-glottal-stop⟧.
text.ja: 渡り音挿入が不可能な場合、すなわちV1が非高母音（*e*、*a*、*o*）であるか、形態統語的理由により渡り音挿入が阻止される場合には、代わりに声門閉鎖音挿入が行われる⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-glide-insertion-is-not-available-glottal-stop⟧。

text.en: Vowel deletion serves as an alternative strategy for resolving hiatus. When two identical adjacent vowels come together, they are reduced to one, as in *kera* + *an* → *keran* 'tasty' ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--two-identical-adjacent-vowels-are-reduced-to-one⟧. When two different vowels come together, the first vowel is normally elided, as in *ine* + *an* + *kur* → *inankur* 'which person' ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-two-different-vowels-come-together-the-first⟧. In forms such as *hawean*, *haweokai*, and *haweash*, the preceding vowel tends to drop when vowels occur in succession, yielding contracted forms *hawan*, *hawokai*, and *hawash* ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-vowels-occur-in-succession-in-hawean-haweokai⟧.
text.ja: 母音削除は母音連続を解消するための代替的方略である。隣接する2つの同一母音は1つに縮約され、例えば*kera* + *an* → *keran*「おいしい」となる⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--two-identical-adjacent-vowels-are-reduced-to-one⟧。2つの異なる母音が隣接する場合、通常最初の母音が脱落し、例えば*ine* + *an* + *kur* → *inankur*「どなた」となる⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-two-different-vowels-come-together-the-first⟧。*hawean*、*haweokai*、*haweash*のような形では、母音が重出する場合に前の母音が落ちやすく、*hawan*、*hawokai*、*hawash*のような縮約形も存在する⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--when-vowels-occur-in-succession-in-hawean-haweokai⟧。

text.en: In the Shizunai dialect, a contrast was observed between *suwat* 'pothook' and *suʔat* 'pot bail', both analyzable as /su-at/, suggesting that the glide and the glottal stop are not freely interchangeable in that dialect ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--in-the-shizunai-dialect-a-contrast-was-observed⟧. Also in the Shizunai dialect, glide insertion takes place in fossilized forms where the semantic transparency of the constituents has been lost, but not in semantically transparent combinations ⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--in-the-shizunai-dialect-glide-insertion-takes-place⟧.
text.ja: 静内方言において、*suwat*「自在鉤」と*suʔat*「鍋のつる」の対立が観察されており、両形はいずれも/su-at/と分析しうることから、渡り音と声門閉鎖音がその方言において自由に交替するわけではないことが示唆される⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--in-the-shizunai-dialect-a-contrast-was-observed⟧。同じく静内方言では、渡り音挿入は構成要素の意味的透明性が失われた化石化した形式において生じ、意味的に透明な組み合わせでは生じない⟦claim:phon/glide-epenthesis-hiatus-resolution--in-the-shizunai-dialect-glide-insertion-takes-place⟧。
